method: Public web search only. Direct reading of any supplier or agency page was attempted for every host below and was denied by this environment's network policy, so NO page was read and NO supplier can be marked verified. 'official_site' sources are search-result snippets of pages on the supplier's own domain (a stronger signal than a directory or press mention, but still not a page read). No supplier was contacted. Phone numbers, e-mail addresses and street addresses seen in third-party results were deliberately not stored.

suppliers.name: Farm to Table LLC
suppliers.service_area: Austin and surrounding areas (per the source)
suppliers.notes: Reported by the Austin Chronicle; no official website was found in search.
sources: Austin Chronicle describes an Austin distributor of locally grown produce to restaurants and school districts.
Listed in the Produce Market Guide as an Austin wholesaler of locally grown farm products; contact details are behind a login and were not recorded.
Trade press describes an Austin-based produce distributor expanding to Houston (an older article; may be out of date).
limitations: No official website found; no published prices.
